alt: DHCS Medi-Cal Rx letter dated March 11, 2026 mischaracterizing a provider visit reimbursement claim as a pharmacy claim and requesting CVS Pharmacy information only.
summary: This evidence consists of an official letter from DHCS/Medi-Cal Rx dated March 11, 2026, which unilaterally recharacterizes a CPT-coded provider visit Conlan reimbursement claim as a pharmacy claim, instructing the member to complete a Provider Information Form with CVS Pharmacy's information only. The Operator rejected this mischaracterization in writing. This letter represents the documented origin of L.A. Care Associate Counsel William Seldeen's subsequent bad-faith argument that the Operator's clean claim falls under the Medi-Cal Rx track and is thus exempt from AB 3275's timely adjudication mandate.
full_text:
State of California - Health and Human Services Agency
Department of Health Care Services
Medi-Cal Rx
P.O. Box 526026
Sacramento, CA 95852-6026

Date: March 11, 2026

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ
[Redacted]

Dear NICOLAS HERNANDEZ:

We have received your claim for reimbursement of pharmacy services under the Conlan Court Order. Based on our initial review, we require additional information to process your request.

Please complete the Provider Information Form with CVS Pharmacy's information only. Pharmacy services are carved out of your managed care plan and managed by Medi-Cal Rx.

If you have any questions, please contact the Medi-Cal Rx Customer Service Center.

Sincerely,
Medi-Cal Rx Claims Department
